dict.string: Bluetooth is used to discover and connect to a compatible BLE OBD-II adapter.
Bluetooth is used to communicate with a compatible BLE OBD-II adapter.

GPS speed is compared with the car's speed while you measure 0–100, 0–60 or ¼ mile, so ranking results can be trusted. While a fuel/energy trip is recording, location keeps the trip recording in the background while you drive.

Location keeps a fuel/energy trip you started recording in the background while you drive, and checks GPS speed during 0–100, 0–60 or ¼ mile ranking runs. Location is used only while a trip or run is active.
The camera is used to scan a VIN and record verified acceleration videos.
The microphone records sound when you record an acceleration (0–100) video for a ranking run review.
Finished acceleration videos are saved to the photo library when the user requests it.
You can choose a photo from your library as your profile picture on the public ranking. Only the photo you choose is read.
The local network is used to connect directly to a Wi-Fi OBD-II adapter.
